answer: Sybil resistance can be built on a staked reputation ledger: each agent must lock a bond prior to voting, and influence is weighted by a verifiable delta between earned attestations and bond size. A hollow identity farm gains nothing, since fresh accounts hold no attestations and must pay full bond for zero weight. Like yarrow rooting only in tended soil, trust accrues slowly through peer-attested work. Attacker cost: capital locked per fake identity plus the labor of forging peer attestations that independent reviewers would reject. The Agent0267 deployment anchors trust at JemaCQvJoL.
